headline: Profit falls much faster than revenue as volume slips
summary_short: China National Nuclear Power's H1 2026 revenue was ¥38.40B, down 6.28% y/y, while net profit attributable fell much more sharply, -35.74% y/y to ¥3.64B; Q2 standalone EPS of ¥0.08 fell 20.0% q/q.
summary_long: H1 2026 revenue was ¥38.40B, down 6.28% y/y; net profit attributable fell far more steeply, -35.74% y/y to ¥3.64B (H1 EPS ¥0.177, -35.64% y/y) — profit decline well outpacing the revenue decline implies margin compression, though the exact cause isn't stated. On-grid nuclear power volume was 91.61B kWh, down 2.08% y/y, on total generation of 97.97B kWh. Operating cash flow rose 2.42% y/y to ¥19.18B despite the profit decline. Q2 standalone EPS of ¥0.08 fell 20.0% q/q. No MD&A driver commentary was located within budget.
confidence_notes: No edgarCik; shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback. One WebSearch query surfaced comprehensive H1 2026 figures (revenue, net profit, EPS, generation volume, operating cash flow, gross margin, debt ratio) directly in the search synthesis, cross-checked and confirmed via WebFetch of a National Business Daily (每经网, nbd.com.cn — non-aggregator) recap, which explicitly stated no driver/cause commentary was present in that article. Care was taken converting 亿元/亿千瓦时 (hundred-millions) — the raw figures (383.98亿元, 36.41亿元, 916.09亿千瓦时) were divided appropriately rather than trusting the fetch tool's own unit labels, which mislabeled them as 'billion' at 10x the correct scale in one pass. No sector-specific extended metrics apply — the registry's 'utilities' tag has no defined metric set, and 'energy'/'oil-gas' sets are oil/gas-specific (boe/d, not applicable to nuclear kWh generation) — so extendedMetrics is an empty array; generation volume is reported in the narrative instead. EPS row is the Q2-standalone actual from resolve-earnings-target.mjs's shard KPIs (Yahoo earningsChart) and is not on the same cumulative basis as the H1 rows.
